correctness.rationale: The exact 99-tetrahedron complex reconstructs the published face vector. Unimodular reduction gives Smith data with 98 unit factors, one factor 2, and one free column, proving the first homology is infinite cyclic plus one order-two summand. Explicit free and mod-two torsion cocycles are checked on every facial relation. Exhaustion of all graph triangles gives exactly 37 null, 112 pure-torsion, 69 primitive-free, and 78 torsion-shifted primitive-free nonfacial triangles.

value.rationale: For a flat three-manifold with mixed first homology, the complete first simple-cycle layer is a natural combinatorial systolic invariant. The result is structurally informative rather than a mere homology recomputation: 37 empty triangles die, 112 realize the unique torsion class, and both torsion lifts of a primitive free generator occur with substantial but unequal multiplicities 69 and 78.
